run_command.description: Execute exactly one approved Saturn command using the caller's trusted capabilities. The selected command's output is delivered to the room.
whenToUse: Use this for an existing Saturn command instead of imitating its output.
Use the command enum as the complete list of commands authorized for this caller; aliases are separate enum values when listed.
whenNotToUse: Do not invent command names or claim a command ran without invoking this tool.
Do not use this tool for general conversation, unsupported operations, or conditional/future actions.
run_command.example: {"command":"weather","arguments":"Tokyo"} - Send weather output to the room

database_query.description: Execute one approved read-only Saturn database query, including bounded recent messages for a requested room. This tool accepts query names, not SQL.
whenToUse: Use for supported counts, room messages, known user identities, and bounded message lookups.
whenNotToUse: Do not pass SQL, invent query names, or use this when a live room_users result is required.

database_schema.description: Inspect the Saturn database schema: tables, columns, indexes, and foreign keys.
whenToUse: Use before database_sql when no approved database_query can answer the request.
whenNotToUse: Do not treat schema metadata as query results or use it when an approved query already fits.

database_sql.description: Run one bounded, read-only SELECT against the schema inspected by database_schema.
whenToUse: Use database_schema first, then use one bounded SELECT only when no approved database_query fits.
whenNotToUse: Never use for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL, multiple statements, or tables outside the inspected schema.
database_sql.example: {"sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages"} - Count rows after schema inspection

room_users.description: Return the live user roster for a Saturn-managed room. Pass room whenever the user names a channel; omit it only for the caller's current room.
whenToUse: Use for current presence, room membership, or questions about who is in a channel now.
whenNotToUse: Do not infer current presence from conversation history or message history.

user_message_history.description: Fetch up to 500 of a named user's latest public messages across all rooms. Pass room only to restrict the search to one channel; omit it to search all rooms. Results include returnedCount, oldestCreatedOn, and newestCreatedOn evidence metadata.
whenToUse: Use freshly for every request about what a named user said or their activity, including 'check it' or 'check elsewhere'. Resolve the nick from shared context when possible.
whenNotToUse: Do not claim a user's history, current presence, or identity without querying the appropriate tool.
user_message_history.example: {"nick":"sun"} - Find recent public messages by sun
